brief_summary: Four side-by-side cross-section panels of boards the hobby has shipped under the leaf-spring banner. Owlab Spring: separate beryllium-copper leaves fixed to the case walls with the plate resting on them. Geonworks F1-8X: aluminium plate with integral tabs resting on an o-ring gasket. Exclusive E7-V2 GML: plate with slotted regions beside its gasket support points and foam between plate and PCB. Mode Sonnet: plate tabs captured inside EPU41 polymer mounting blocks. The spring element in each panel is bordeaux; a serif footnote names each board's damping element.
